instruction: Create a bzip2 archive of all files in the "/tmp/test_files" directory tree that were last modified 30 days ago

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'if find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name "*.tar.bz2" -type f | grep -q .; then if tar -tjf $(find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name "*.tar.bz2" -type f | head -1) 2>/dev/null | grep -q "old_file"; then echo "Success: Old files archived with bzip2"; else echo "Fail: Archive does not contain old files"; fi; else echo "Fail: No tar.bz2 archive found"; fi'

include: Success: Old files archived with bzip2

metadata.explanation: Task requires archiving files modified 30 days ago into a tar.bz2 file. Uses command-line verification to check if a tar.bz2 archive exists in /tmp and contains the old files. No custom functions needed - reuses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Wrong verification scope: Searches for archive in /tmp only, not verifying it contains files specifically from /tmp/test_files directory tree
Incomplete temporal verification: Does not verify that archived files were actually modified 30 days ago - only checks if 'old_file' string exists in archive contents
Missing completeness check: Does not verify that ALL files from /tmp/test_files modified 30 days ago are included in the archive
Missing exclusivity check: Does not verify that ONLY files modified 30 days ago are archived (no newer or older files)

Fragile file name assumption: Relies on files containing 'old_file' in their name, which is not guaranteed by the instruction - this assumption may come from setup.sh but is not semantically verifying the actual requirement
Missing source directory validation: Does not verify the archive was created from the /tmp/test_files directory tree specifically
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Verify archive contains files from /tmp/test_files path structure (check tar listing output contains 'test_files' directory paths)
Add verification that checks the actual modification time of files in the archive against 30 days ago threshold
Verify completeness by counting expected files vs archived files, or by comparing against a known list from setup
Improve the grep pattern to check for actual file paths from /tmp/test_files, not just 'old_file' string
Consider using 'find /tmp/test_files -mtime 30' to generate expected file list, then verify all those files are in archive
Verify no unexpected files are in the archive by checking that all archived files match the 30-day modification criteria
